tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search for a book across every bookseller Near Fine covers for the buyer's country (AbeBooks and eBay sites everywhere, plus World of Books, ThriftBooks, Casa del Libro, Hugendubel, Booklooker, Leslibraires.fr, Rarewaves, Ex Libris, Librairie Mollat, Boekwinkeltjes.nl, Standaard Boekhandel, Manageme

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the bookseller catalogs Near Fine searches, each with the countries it serves. Pass a country to see only the sources that serve buyers there.

tools.name: set_alert

Near Fine checks the alert for six months and emails them once when a new listing turns up with everything the query asks for, such as a first edition, a signed copy or a price cap. tools.name: cancel_alert
tools.description: Cancel one of the person's alerts on Near Fine by its id, from list_alerts or set_alert, deleting it as its Delete button on Near Fine does. The first time, they sign in. Returns the cancelled alert and the person's plan.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_books, set_alert, list_alerts · Public sink: search_books · Destructive: cancel_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_books, set_alert, list_alerts · Public sink: search_books · Destructive: cancel_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
